vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: claw-cleaning
Version: 1.0.3

The skill facilitates apartment cleaning bookings in San Francisco via an external MCP server (https://claw.cleaning/mcp). It follows a standard booking flow, collecting necessary PII (name, email, address) and handling payments through Stripe or in-person. The instructions include safety checks, such as requiring explicit user confirmation before initiating bookings and verifying Stripe checkout URLs. No malicious code, obfuscation, or prompt injection attempts were identified.

llm.summary: This instruction-only skill is internally consistent: it drives an external MCP booking service (claw.cleaning) to list slots and create bookings, and it does not request local installs, system access, or unrelated credentials.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the instructions: all actions are booking-related (check availability, initiate booking, check status) against the declared MCP endpoint. No unrelated env vars, binaries, or installs are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md only instructs the agent to call the MCP tools and to collect customer booking details (name, email, SF address, payment choice). It does not request system files or other credentials. Note: the skill asks the user/agent to add an external MCP connector (https://claw.cleaning/mcp); connecting to an external endpoint is expected for this purpose but carries trust risk outside the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — the skill is instruction-only, so nothing is written to disk or downloaded by the skill package.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. Runtime behavior mentions Stripe checkout URLs and saved cards (handled by the MCP), which is appropriate for a booking/payment flow and does not require local secrets.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request permanent system presence or modify other skills' configs. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but not excessive given the task.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says, but it operates by connecting your agent to an external MCP endpoint (https://claw.cleaning/mcp). Before adding or using it: 1) verify you trust claw.cleaning (confirm domain and organization); 2) follow the SKILL.md guidance to only share payment links that resolve to checkout.stripe.com; 3) inform customers that first-time pay-now bookings save cards and future bookings may auto-charge that card; 4) be cautious when adding a custom MCP connector — only add connectors from services you trust; and 5) consider limiting autonomous invocation or testing with a dummy booking first if you want to observe behavior before allowing broad use.
